title: Explore More Communities with Reddit’s New Feed Updates
summary: Reddit introduces new feed options for users, driving discovery of communities while giving greater control over their feeds.
body_markdown:
[Product and Community](https://redditinc.com/news/tag/product-and-community)[Announcements](https://redditinc.com/news/tag/announcements)


October 28, 2026


Every day, millions of people come to Reddit to connect around what matters to them- sharing experiences, learning from one another, and finding a sense of belonging in communities of all kinds.


We’ve been working on the feed experience to help users discover even more of what Reddit has to offer, finding more opportunities for connection, participation, and belonging while also giving them more control over what appears in their feed. That’s why, today, we are introducing a new feed experience that offers users the choice between two feeds - For You


and


Following


feeds


.


This new feed experience is a first step in helping drive discovery that leads to something novel and relevant - an idea, a connection, a unique perspective, or even a new interest. A more human internet is not just something you sit back and watch, it is something you find value in and want to participate in.


##### For You vs Following feeds


The new feed experience gives users a clearer choice between discovering new communities and conversations


or catching up on the communities they've already joined


,


empowering the user to decide how they want to experience Reddit. This experience will be rolling out globally over the next few weeks. Users can effortlessly switch between feeds anytime and return to the one they last viewed the next time they open Reddit.


-


For You


combines posts from communities you have joined with recommendations related to your interests. It can help you discover relevant communities and conversations you might not otherwise come across.


-


Following


only shows posts from communities you have joined, for a focused way to catch up on those specific communities.


What We Are Working Toward


At Reddit, good recommendations should help people follow an interest into a community, and from there, into a conversation. Across thousands of communities, discovery can help people find others who get them, encounter perspectives that broaden their own, and take part in something bigger while sharing their own experiences. We will continue experimenting with ways people can more intentionally explore Reddit - from new ways to navigate based on their interests to more controls that help them shape their feed, like hiding posts and indicating what they’d like to see less of. That feedback can help make recommendations more relevant and easier to navigate. As we learn from these experiments, we’ll keep working to help people find communities they want to return to and conversations they want to be a part of.
